transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function using an explicit `slice: &mut [T]` receiver parameter and the source `F: FnMut() -> T` callback parameter.

Mechanically represented the Rust `for el in self { *el = f(); }` traversal as a Verus index loop so proof-only invariants can expose the written prefix and untouched suffix; the executable data flow still visits every element once, obtains one callback result for that position, borrows the mutable element, and writes it.

Lowered the direct callback expression `f()` to the harness-local `zero_arg_fnmut_call_at(&mut f, ...)` boundary. The boundary body is exactly `f()` and carries only the audited `zero_arg_fnmut_outputs` observation for the current call index; the public target function is not `external_body`.
Instantiated the generated `zero_arg_fnmut_outputs` vocabulary and its length axiom from the frozen shared slice vocabulary; added proof-only loop invariants and a termination measure.
